Attack Vector: The problem lies in deserializing JSON back to Java objects. When a poorly written Java application has the ability to deserialize a JSON string from an untrusted source, a hacker can use this to launch a remote code execution. If polymorphic typing is activated for Jackson, an attacker can use a gadget to launch their attack when they control the JSON input.
Indicators of Compromise: A gadget from Ehcache could be misused when default typing in Jackson is enabled.

Method of Attack: Dependency on the older vulnerable jackson-databind 2.9.9 package
Attack Vector: Building a new Spring-Boot application using the Spring Boot Initialzr will definitely have a vulnerable jackson-databind version included.
